turns.prompt_text: how can images be shared without losing quality
turns.response_html:
The best ways to share images without losing quality are by using cloud storage services, dedicated file transfer tools, or direct device-to-device transfer.

  • Cloud Storage/File Transfer Services: Platforms like Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Photos, SmugMug, Flickr, WeTransfer, or Filemail allow you to upload the original, full-resolution file and share a link for the recipient to download it.
  • Direct Transfers: For nearby users, AirDrop (Apple devices) and Wi-Fi Direct are fast methods that transfer the original file.
  • Physical Media: For the absolute highest quality and largest files (like RAW images), transferring via an external hard drive or USB flash drive is a foolproof, though less convenient, method.
  • Email or Messaging Apps: Send the image as a document/file attachment instead of an in-line image to prevent automatic compression, but be aware of file size limits (usually 10-25MB). Compressing multiple files into a ZIP or RAR archive also ensures they are sent losslessly.

To ensure quality is maintained, use lossless file formats like PNG, TIFF, or the original RAW file, and avoid using services (like most social media or chat apps) that automatically compress images.
